title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30330: add OnCancelInvoiceOnBeforeConfirm event
summary: An integration event enables extensions to adjust the confirmation message shown when cancelling a posted sales invoice, ensuring the text matches any customized behavior for restoring quantities.
key_points: New integration event OnCancelInvoiceOnBeforeConfirm in codeunit 1323
Confirmation text is now stored in a variable that subscribers can modify
Allows extensions to reflect customized order quantity behavior in the confirmation dialog
Integrates with existing extensibility for handling originating order quantities
